ROB_NO_ROOM: No room for the loot in your inventory
ROB_ERR_POLICE: Not enough police in the city
ROB_ERR_ITEM: You do not have the right tool
ROB_ERR_WEAPON: You need a weapon in your hands
ADMIN_TAB_PLACES_DESC: Stores, banks and other places that can be robbed, with their police rules and cooldown.
ADMIN_C_PLACE_DESC: Where the police are sent and how long the place stays empty after a robbery.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: Where the police alert points to.
ADMIN_H_MIN_POLICE: On-duty officers needed before anything here can be robbed.
ADMIN_H_COOLDOWN: How long a robbed target stays empty (and an opened door open).
ADMIN_H_ALERT: Chance that the first robbery of a visit alerts the police (once per cooldown).
ADMIN_TAB_TARGETS_DESC: What can be robbed: registers, safes, lockers, vitrines and doors. Each names its place.
ADMIN_C_TARGET_DESC: Stand at the spot the robber works at and use your position.
ADMIN_H_PLACE: The id of the place this target belongs to.
ADMIN_H_KIND: Decides the animation. Vitrines need a weapon in hand; doors open instead of paying; a house door breaks in (the place needs an interior).
ADMIN_H_TARGET_COORDS: The robber must stand within 2.5 m of it.
ADMIN_H_ITEM: Item the robber must carry. Empty: none.
ADMIN_C_DOOR_DESC: Door targets open a door until the place's cooldown ends.
ADMIN_H_DOOR: The id of a door in ai-doorlock. Empty: the vault object below swings instead.
ADMIN_H_VAULT_MODEL: A map object within 6 m of the spot, turned locally on every client.
ADMIN_C_REWARD_DESC: Money and items the robber gets when the time runs out.
ADMIN_H_REWARD: Item given with the money. Empty: none.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Who counts as police and where stolen money goes.
ADMIN_H_POLICE_JOBS: On-duty members of these jobs count for 'Police needed'.
ADMIN_H_ACCOUNT: Stolen money goes to this account of the robber.
ROB_PROMPT_TRUCK_PLANT: Plant the charge on the rear doors
ROB_TRUCK_STARTED: An armored truck is parked where the map shows. Deal with the guards first.
ROB_ERR_TRUCK_BUSY: A truck job is already running
ROB_ERR_TRUCK_WAIT: No trucks right now, come back later
ROB_ERR_MONEY: Not enough money in the bank
ADMIN_C_HOUSE_DESC: Set an interior to make this place a house: its door target breaks in and takes the robber inside.
ADMIN_H_INTERIOR: Where robbers appear inside (and leave from). Leave at 0, 0, 0 for places that are not houses.
ADMIN_C_TRUCK_DESC: A robber pays at the giver, a guarded truck parks at a random spawn; guards down, charge on the rear doors, cash.
ADMIN_H_TRUCK_GIVER: Where robbers ask for the job. Leave at 0, 0, 0 to turn trucks off.
ADMIN_H_TRUCK_ITEM: Spent to blow the rear doors.
ADMIN_DELETE_PLACE_DESC: Its targets stop working until they name another place.
